originalSemantics.measure: Non-ignored file hunk added+deleted lines; API file changes equals additions+deletions and is checked.
originalSemantics.ignored: Only root pnpm-lock.yaml; .gitignore force included; nested lock and lock suffix paths included. Rename counts if either old or new path is not ignored.
originalSemantics.labels: Keep unrelated labels; add missing desired size label before removing stale size/*; do not rewrite already-correct label or create/update label color.

fix.runtime: Official action uses node24; no application dependency/package/lock change.
fix.readProtocol: GET metadata; reject stale event/head or>3000 files; fixed100-item pages with expected-length, unique-name and numeric validation; require empty terminal page and aggregate totals; GET metadata again and compare head/base/count/totals before any label write.
fix.failuresBeforeWrites: Incomplete/duplicate/extra pages,>3000, metadata mismatch, head/base change, malformed labels or any read API error throw before label mutations.
fix.notAtomic: Label mutations retain original add-then-remove order. They are not a transaction; later write API failures cannot undo an already completed mutation. The final revision fence precedes the write phase and is not an atomic GitHub compare-and-swap.
